description: Ranks brokerage branch seats (营业部) by dragon-tiger activity: appearances, cumulative buying, and how their picks opened the NEXT session. Counting is deduplicated by (day, exchange, security, seat). ⚠️ Read `win_rate_pct` with `win_samples` — small samples are noise (`min_appearances` gates win-rate sorting). ⚠️ 机构专用 and 沪/深股通专用 are shared placeholder names, not individual seats — excluded by default; request them explicitly and check `is_aggregate`. No per-seat NET figures (Shanghai discloses one side per seat).

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

min_appearances.description: Minimum appearances to qualify (default 3). Also gates win-rate sample count when sorting by win rate.

seat_type.description: Restrict to one seat kind. Omit for branches only — the meaningful leaderboard.

name: dragon_tiger_seats
